## Indian Classical Carnatic Music

I have been learning Carnatic Music since the age of five. I started learning from Smt. Shyamala Krishna in Kansas and later was under the tutelage of Smt. Geetha Ganesh in Cary, Sri Malladi Suribabu, and Smt. Malladi Vasavi in India. Currently, I am learning from Sri. Madurai R. Sundar in Detroit and have given performances througout the U.S. and India. Here is one of my recent concerts and a lecture-demonstration on the "Pancha Bhuta Linga Kritis of Sri Muthuswami Dikshitar."
